brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Schedule a repair technician to inspect and fix a malfunctioning refrigerator.
facts: The caller's refrigerator stopped cooling yesterday.
The appliance is a Whirlpool double-door model.
The caller is located at 742 Evergreen Terrace.
preferences: Prefers an afternoon appointment window to avoid work conflicts.
Wants confirmation of the diagnostic fee before booking.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit including the call-out fee and any parts fitted

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Appliance Repair.

script.label: Main Menu
script.text: For service scheduling, press 1. For billing questions, press 2.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling service scheduling. My name is Alex, how can I assist you today?

script.label: Request Details
script.text: Could you please share your address and the type of appliance needing repair?

script.label: Hold For Lookup
script.text: Thank you, please give me just a moment while I look up our technician availability and rates in your area...

script.label: Return From Hold
script.text: Thanks for your patience, I have that information ready now.

script.label: Quote Pricing
script.text: Our standard diagnostic service visit fee is exactly 160 dollars.

script.label: Offer Window
script.text: Our next available opening in your area is this Thursday between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

script.label: Confirm Booking
script.text: Perfect, I have you officially booked for Thursday between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

script.label: Closing Inquiry
script.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

script.label: Call Sign-off
script.text: Thank you for choosing Apex Appliance Repair. Have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
